title: Sarah Wynn-Williams’s memoir about working at Facebook, Careless People: A Cautionary Tale...
content: Sarah Wynn-Williams’s memoir about working at Facebook, Careless People: A Cautionary Tale of Power, Greed, and Lost Idealism (Bookshop), is on the bestseller charts after Meta tried to get the book pulled from sale. The Streisand effect strikes again.
author: Jason Kottke
